Celestia 2.0

Think it. Prompt it. Code it.

  • Celestia 2.0 returns bigger than ever with a Prompt Engineering Workshop followed by a 24-hour beginner-friendly hackathon focused on innovation, collaboration and AI-powered development.
  • Designed for students who want to turn ideas into working solutions, Celestia 2.0 brings together technology, creativity and product thinking across six diverse tracks: Dev Tools, Open Innovation, SDG, Hardware, EdTech and Healthcare.
  • Whether you are an experienced developer or taking your first steps into hackathons, Celestia 2.0 provides an opportunity to learn, build, experiment with AI and transform ideas into impactful solutions.

Event Highlights:

Prompting Bootcamp:

  • Kickstart your hackathon journey with a dedicated Prompt Engineering Workshop designed to help participants effectively use AI tools for ideation, development and problem-solving.

24-Hour Hackathon:

  • Work with your team to develop an innovative solution to a real-world problem.
  • AI tools, frameworks and libraries are permitted and encouraged throughout the hackathon.

Six Tracks:

  • Dev Tools
  • Open Innovation
  • SDG
  • Hardware
  • EdTech
  • Healthcare

Mentorship & Reviews:

  • Teams will go through multiple review stages where their progress, ideas and implementations will be evaluated before the final shortlist.

Final Pitches:

  • Shortlisted teams will present their solutions to the judges, showcasing their innovation, technical implementation, product thinking and potential real-world impact.

What Will Be Evaluated:

  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Creativity & Innovation
  • Technical Implementation
  • Presentation & Pitching
  • Product Thinking
  • Real-world Relevance and Impact

Event Details:

  • Eligibility: Current undergraduate students
  • Team Size: 3–5 members
  • Registration Fee: ₹354 (inclusive of GST)
  • Format: Offline, on-site hackathon
  • Duration: 24 hours
  • Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers, extension cords, headphones and other required technical equipment.
  • All ideas and solutions must be original, and plagiarism or malpractice will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Come with an idea, use the power of prompting, build with AI and turn your vision into reality.
  • You can complete the payment after registering on Unstop: https://gravitas.vit.ac.in/events/d1db152c-3715-48bb-a8d4-3b0da0a68c29

Think it. Prompt it. Code it.
